name: Scan to Plan
summary:
**Your headset can measure your home. This draws the 2D floor plan.**

Moving, letting, insuring, quoting a builder - something always wants a floor plan. Your Meta Quest can map the walls, doors, windows and furniture itself. Set your space up once and the plan is waiting; if you have not, the app takes you there.

# 1:1 overlay
The plan over your rooms in passthrough, full size, in place. Walls and furniture outlined where they stand, named and measured.

# Miniature
Your whole home as a model before you.
